mentions.name: Segtax
mentions.description: A startup focused on cost segregation, a niche accounting professional service, that is working toward automating the bulk of the work involved.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I started a company to focus on the niche accounting professional service called Cost Segregation in the summer of 2024. I was laid off from Meta in February 2025 and dove in full-time on that startup, Segtax.

We are on the cusp of automating the bulk of the work.
